business_summary: American International Group, Inc. (NYSE: AIG) is a global insurance holding company and one of the largest US commercial property-casualty and general insurers, with a long-established ocean marine and specialty-lines business. It sits on the hormuz-maritime chain's war-risk-reinsurance-capacity and marine-war-risk-underwriting links. On war-risk-reinsurance-capacity: named partner insurer in the US International Development Finance Corporation maritime war-risk reinsurance facility standing behind the Gulf marine war account. On marine-war-risk-underwriting: US ocean-marine underwriting group whose hull and cargo book reprices on the Gulf war-risk shock; ranked in the NAIC national ocean marine top ten.

exposure_summary.narrative: American International Group sits on two links: war-risk-reinsurance-capacity, scored EMERGING (impact 78, crowdedness 55, capture 52): capacity had to be manufactured rather than bought (a sovereign DFC facility and a separate Lloyd's market consortium), and the trade press's own read is that the episode has not been profitable in aggregate so far; and marine-war-risk-underwriting, scored CROWDED (impact 85, crowdedness 62, capture 45): the chain's own repricing_check reads ATTENTION_WITHOUT_EARNINGS (1 of 4 legs met) because no cited source sizes marine war revenue at any listed insurer even though the premium headline (war-risk cover from roughly 1-3% to 7.5-10% of hull value) has moved. On war-risk-reinsurance-capacity: Named partner insurer in the US International Development Finance Corporation maritime war-risk reinsurance facility standing behind the Gulf marine war account. On marine-war-risk-underwriting: US ocean-marine underwriting group whose hull and cargo book reprices on the Gulf war-risk shock; ranked in the NAIC national ocean marine top ten.
